newsitem.title: USA: Fruit of the Loom sees lower Q2 results.
newsitem.headline: Fruit of the Loom sees lower Q2 results.

text.p: Fruit of the Loom Inc said Friday it expects to report second quarter earnings of $0.28 to $0.32 a share, down from $0.63 a year ago.

The apparel maker, whose brands include Fruit of the Loom, BVD and Gitano, cited excessive inventory levels at wholesale activewear accounts, and widespread promotional activity in the highly competitive wholesale activewear market.
Second quarter sales are estimated at $640 million, down from $732.2 million a year earlier, it said.
Revenues in the second quarter of 1996 included $34.3 million of hosiery sales. The company sold its hosiery business to Renfro Corp in November 1996.
Fruit of the Loom will report second quarter results July 23.
Shares of Fruit of the Loom closed yesterday at 28.
